headline: Brazil Stocks Slip 0.8% on Wall Street Rout and Fiscal Concerns
summary: Brazil's stock market fell 0.82% amid a Wall Street rout and fiscal doubts, pushing the real to 5.5032 per dollar, its weakest close in at least six months.
why: Emerging market equities and currencies often face downward pressure during broader global risk-off events, particularly when compounded by domestic fiscal concerns.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Brazilian Real
impacts.why: The input explicitly states the real weakened to 5.5032 per dollar.
